decisions.text: 新桌面独立打包到 lib/main；空 bundle 启动前拒绝，非精确资产路径在 main 终止，旧 renderer 未提交内容不覆盖。
constraints: build required before Host startup
no old document fallback
preserve parked edits

decisions.text: T01 只消费现有状态读取的真实响应，区分 denial 与有效投影，损坏或超时不可用且不泄漏原始消息。
constraints: same-origin GET only
no invented runtime facts
bounded read

decisions.text: 输入草稿跨读取、拒绝和导航保留；成功任务发送仍需后续 custody 和权限接线，本片无业务 POST。
constraints: no premature draft clear
no synthetic accepted receipt

decisions.text: dev 默认不注入 fixture/辅助窗变量，GUI 子进程不继承 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE；测试与 Host 模式不变。
constraints: isolated dev root
test and Host execution unchanged

decisions.text: 默认桌面、单个服务结果和完整业务闭环分别验收；T01 与206挂载均不能关闭总集成目标。
constraints: successful chat remains required
no release claim
no automatic commit or push

adrs.title: ADR-0266 · 本机系统入口：GET /.sage/bootstrap 与 local-system 类别

decisions.text: 新增 GET /.sage/bootstrap 作为唯一 local-system 路由（59 条中的 1 条），响应为封闭 DTO：runtime 状态枚举、auth.status、requested theme/density。
constraints: no name, credential, session ref, config value, workspace or business content
matrix registers localSystemAdmission fact

decisions.text: main 组装专属 runner：caller → ready/未污染 frame（锁 generation）→ 读取 → 读后 generation 不变 → 读中身份状态不变；任一步失败回单一稳定拒码 bootstrap-unavailable。
constraints: same code for every denial (no oracle)
no runner keeps the same stable denial

decisions.text: 门禁以逐行事实登记新类别：EXPECTED_ROUTES 58→59、local-system 分类与 policy/authority 模式、runner 源码精确针与负向针、自测四个具名突变。
constraints: no exemptions added
existing read/write policies unchanged

decisions.text: renderer 以 exactKeys 封闭解析，不显示未分类字段；账号菜单登录仅显式点击触发，logout 确认后立即重读 state 与 bootstrap 撤回旧状态。
constraints: no auto login
logout withdraws immediately

decisions.text: bootstrap 不是业务读取通行证：state/search 等路由 admission 不变，未登录仍拒绝。
constraints: no policy relaxation
no route reuse

adrs.title: ADR-0267 · 读策略接线：选择时读授权与投影读取策略（T03 授权）

decisions.text: index.ts 以唯一 memoised readPolicyFor() 组装读策略，并把 authorizeMatterRead / authorizeProjectionRead 双钉点接为 policy 调用（T03 授权）。
constraints: ledger survives across requests (no per-request rebuild)
old explicit-absent pins must not return

decisions.text: 读策略只授予 local-read 且无需 decision 的授予；选择时 matter.read、读取时逐 operation projection.read；无会话/文件不可读→unavailable，负答/越界/无绑定/跨策略版本→denied。
constraints: no write authority
no default-true path
high-entropy actor scope minted at selection only

decisions.text: route-authority 门禁把该接线登记为逐行事实（导入/单例/双接线精确针＋旧钉死与每请求重建负向针），成功 note 与矩阵 runtimeLevel 同步改述。
constraints: no exemptions added
no fail-closed relaxation

decisions.text: 自测新增 4 条具名突变（unwire projection / unwire matter / drop import / per-request rebuild），每条必须具名红。
constraints: mutations isolate to the owner check
named failure, not crash

decisions.text: collection/opaque-object 读取与写面、local-system 面均不改：仍按既有 unavailable/denied 语义。
constraints: no route reuse
no admission relaxation

adrs.title: ADR-0268 · 设备聚合读的 collection 授权（T03/A）

decisions.text: candidate-match 对 collection 'state' 放行（active-matter 授权覆盖设备聚合读）；file-reference 是当前唯一允许的 opaque resolver，必须同时匹配 fresh scope 的 matterRef 与 trustedWorkspaceRoot；其余 collection 与 opaque 资源维持 unavailable。
constraints: no other collection resolved
no other opaque resolver
unknown and cross-scope references share unavailable

decisions.text: 放行前提全部沿用既有准入链：caller、initial-context、main-owned 读策略（local-read）、fresh scope 全字段匹配、读前后新鲜度；任一不成立仍是 unavailable/denied/stale。
constraints: no fail-closed relaxation
no new authority source
renderer cannot mint matter or workspace authority

decisions.text: route-authority 门禁登记 state 与 file-reference source-read 放行事实及负向针；edit-drafts/create 保持 protected-effect 分类，source read 必须使用 edit-drafts.create、opaque file-reference candidate 和 scope.matterRef 注入。
constraints: no exemptions added
source-read admission is not full command authority
runCommand remains required and false

decisions.text: projection-read-production 护栏覆盖 state 放行、search 维持 candidate-match unavailable、其他 opaque 资源封锁，以及 file-reference 的 matching/unknown/cross-matter/cross-workspace 分支；批-4 的全封禁默认由本条决策取代的范围仅限明确绑定的 resolver。
constraints: superseding record kept in ADR
no existence oracle

decisions.text: 聚合响应只含 main-owned 投影；设备级槽位随授权对已签入会话可见（A 的已知暴露面，用户接受），窄化（B）如需要另开票。edit-drafts/create 的本地草案创建仍需后续完整 protected command authority。
constraints: no renderer/Host passthrough
B remains available as a future ticket
T03 source-read convergence is not full live completion

adrs.title: ADR-0269 · Sanbao 206 状态采用逐行五维交付矩阵，不以页面目录代替集成

decisions.text: 206 状态的唯一 tracked 进度事实家是 state map；source pin、catalog/ledger digest、206 distinct IDs 与 59 groups 必须可重算。
constraints: one progress authority
source pin required

decisions.text: 每行按 UI、Application Service、Host、Electron acceptance、visual acceptance 五维验收；required 全 verified 且证据 tracked/non-fixture/non-ignored 才能 integrated。
constraints: no plan-as-delivery
N/A requires decision and rationale

decisions.text: prototype observation、Pages、旧 renderer、旧 DSH DMG、ignored candidate 与截图存在都不能提升 Sage 集成状态。
constraints: prototype is evidence input only
legacy is not Sage acceptance

decisions.text: generator check、独立 matrix gate/test 进入 Sage global gate；summary 只能派生，手工篡改必须失败。
constraints: no exemptions added
summary derived only

decisions.text: 内部 DMG 与 206 功能收敛并行但正交；任何 DMG 都要报告当时真实矩阵计数，不能把可安装冒充 206/206。
constraints: DMG is not integration proof
initial integrated count is zero

adrs.title: ADR-0270 · 设备偏好独立 GET、权威回读与默认桌面设置主链

decisions.text: GET /.sage/device-preferences 是独立 local-system read：verified caller、ready/uncontaminated frame、同代 freshness 与 identity-stable read，失败统一 device-preferences-unavailable。
constraints: no matter/session admission reuse
signed-out read allowed

decisions.text: 成功 DTO 只含 requested 八项、canonical savedAt 与 effectiveTheme；main 以 exact keys/enum 验证，身份、路径、business facts、systemDark/applies 禁止外流。
constraints: closed DTO
no secret or identity detail

decisions.text: GET runner 只读 sealed preference projection，禁止调用 mutation port；保存无论结果都以随后权威 GET 更新 UI/root，不做 optimistic projection。
constraints: POST receipt is not read authority
one in-flight save

decisions.text: 默认桌面 root mount 即读偏好；theme/density 权威回读后 live apply，其余六项只保存并明示未应用。
constraints: unknown on unavailable
no invented defaults

decisions.text: route authority 为 60 routes/2 local-system，两个 local-system route 分别提供 exact source proof，并以 coordinated-drift mutation tests 防假绿。
constraints: GET/read/provider immutable
no exemptions added

adrs.title: ADR-0271 · Sage 0.1.0 采用独立本机自签内测 DMG 链

decisions.text: Sage 内测打包只走 packaging-sage；产品事实固定为 com.lute.sage、0.1.0、build 1、arm64、internal，不调用 legacy packaging。
constraints: one packaging namespace
no legacy completion evidence

decisions.text: 输入必须由已构建 production graph 与隔离 materializeProfile 产生；第三方发布包默认保留，仅允许 exact package/version/path 平台投影。
constraints: no source tree input
no current user profile
fail closed native projection

decisions.text: 签名只接受 Sage Local Code Signing 当次短期本机自签身份，经 SecurityAgent 人工 trust 门，叶到根且无 timestamp，并由 receipt v2 逐 target 证明同一 signer。
constraints: internal only
no other local identity
manual trust approval

decisions.text: signing/DMG mutation 需 --execute；DMG 创建后必须 verify/mount/copy/seal/relocatability/tree-digest，覆盖 owned output 需 --replace。
constraints: plan is non-mutating
relative manifests only

decisions.text: DMG-06 以 fresh root 首启和同根重启验证设置读写及持久化，只有 packaged acceptance v1 passed evidence 才算通过，且不冒充 T05/T06 或 206 状态完成。
constraints: artifact is not feature completion
packaged Electron evidence required

decisions.text: metadata v4 分开 raw input 与 signing-normalized assembly digest；HEAD 只是上下文，dirty worktree 不得冒充 commit 可重建来源。
constraints: honest dirty provenance
byte digests are authoritative

adrs.title: ADR-0272 · 可回退清理、跨仓资源收纳与异机交接基线

decisions.text: 删除前必须完成逐 worktree 只读保全（差异补丁、untracked/ignored tar、唯一提交判定），恢复集固定在仓外 Sage-recovery-20261006-cleanup。
constraints: no delete without preservation receipt
recovery set is not a runtime dependency

decisions.text: 保全核验通过后注销 Sage 侧 worktree 注册并删除对应目录；Magpie-Horch 侧注册状态只读不动。
constraints: external repo read-only
no force flags on shared state

decisions.text: Sanbao 原型以 vendor/sanbao-prototype（含 .git）+ pin 收纳；surface 与 crawl 发现新增仓内候选，env 覆盖最先、兄弟仓降为历史回退。
constraints: pin records HEAD and digests
generator --check-source must pass from vendored root

decisions.text: 设计回路资料收纳到 docs/design-loop，判者收纳到 scripts/design-loop 且默认宿主仓相对入口；历史读数不得冒充现行验收。
constraints: tracked matrix and tickets remain authoritative
no machine-absolute defaults

decisions.text: 品牌源 SVG 收纳到 assets/sanbao-logo-kit（assets/sage 只允许 manifest 列出的条目，任何多余条目会被精确对账判红），SHA-256 必须与生成器 expectedSourceSha256 一致；资产批准状态不变。
constraints: byte-identical source
unapproved stays unapproved

decisions.text: cleanup-inventory 将引用扫描失败落为 unknown（阻断删除建议），射程纳入 --untracked 与 packaging-sage，并有负控与单元测试。
constraints: unavailable scan must never read as no references
negative control flips suggested to unknown

decisions.text: 清理不触碰 LUTE 签名私钥与活跃打包锁；不自动 commit/push；未在新机重跑的验证标注待新机验证。
constraints: keys retained
stale lock only registered
no commit or push

adrs.title: ADR-0273 · legacy packages 解耦与减重（加载期脱离 quarantine 区）

decisions.text: gate.mjs 与 role-brief-shape.mjs 对 packages/ 的静态 import 改为容错 TLA（缺源为 null），受影响的 legacy 检查运行期 fail-closed 并给出 git checkout 恢复提示；Sage 域行为零变化。
constraints: no async runner change
sage checks unchanged
fail closed with recovery hint

decisions.text: 整目录缺席消融必须证明两域 --list 正常与缺源 fail-closed，随后原样恢复且工作区零差异。
constraints: reversible rename only
no partial state

decisions.text: 减重只删 packages/**/node_modules 与 eval/out 等 ignored 重物；跟踪源码、锁与 lib 构建物保留；重装走逐包 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile。
constraints: no tracked file deleted
locks retained
reinstall documented

decisions.text: legacy 源码的整体退役须另批完成：撤白名单条目、退役或迁移 legacy 检查、审查 acceptance 引用面，三者同批。
constraints: no directory-only deletion
gitignore ghosts handled
checks retired with subjects

adrs.title: ADR-0274 · 首页耐用事项创建：Sage 自有权威存储成为真实托管方（T04）

decisions.text: 托管方 = Sage 自有权威事件存储：main-owned matter-custody.ts 以 not-exists append 落地创建（matter-created + 首个 revision-entered，单事务批次）；ADR-0201 的落点条款被取代，其余语义保留。
constraints: main is the only writer
single transactional batch
ADR-0201 branch and codes retained

decisions.text: 正式身份与幂等来自服务签发 correlation：matterId=matter:<correlation>、revisionId=revision:1、appendId=draft-conversion:<correlation>；重复调用经指纹幂等或流内证明结算，绝不重复建流。
constraints: renderer candidate never becomes the formal id
conflicts require in-stream proof
no duplicate stream

decisions.text: 回执只从提交证明产生：appended/replayed 或流内证明的冲突 → receiptRef；commit-unknown → {unknown:true}；storage-busy/invalid-request/断言拒绝 → denied；打不开/关闭/blocked → undefined。
constraints: unknown is never retryable
no receipt without proof
unavailable shares the step-3 doctrine

decisions.text: reconcile 只读流内事实：已证明 → settled；not-found → unknown（查不到仍未知）；存储不可用 → unknown/custodian-query-unavailable；占位查询从 composition root 退场且不得回潮。
constraints: never auto-settle
no placeholder in index

decisions.text: route-authority 门禁登记 custody 源码事实（index 构造与两条接线、显式 options-gated 合并、not-exists/appendId/派生/commit-unknown→unknown/查询保持 unknown、占位码不得在 index）附具名突变；matrix 两行 runtimeLevel 同步改述。
constraints: no exemptions added
counts unchanged
named mutations per fact

adrs.title: ADR-0275 · 会话族真实 Identity 准入（T05 第一刀）

decisions.text: 登记 session.send（role:owner / session.send / session.prompt / external-write / requiresDecision:false）；登记=让请求可评估，不是授权，放行仍取决于组织策略精确 grant。
constraints: registration is not authorization
no per-message decision gate
consumers unchanged

decisions.text: assembleSessionCoreAuthorizationRequest 与 assembleAuthorizationRequest 共用同一核心与同一张表。
constraints: one table
existing assembly behavior unchanged

decisions.text: 唯一适配器：未登记操作在任何策略读取之前答 unavailable；无会话/策略不可读答 unavailable；非 authorized 答 denied；authorized 产出不透明 actorScopeRef（actor 稳定）与 decisionRef（求值新鲜）。
constraints: no policy read for unregistered operations
raw issuer handle organization never surface
denials never lie as not-ready and vice versa

decisions.text: 接线只在 options.authority 存在时合并；登记只做 session.send 一条，其余操作按各自票据逐条登记。
constraints: absent authority keeps the step absent
one operation per deliberate edit

decisions.text: 门禁登记 gated merge、条目与 scope、未登记先于读取、非 authorized→denied、assembly+kernel resolve 五组源码事实，附六条具名突变；计数与分类不变。
constraints: no exemptions added
counts unchanged
named mutations per fact

adrs.title: ADR-0276 · T05 中段：session.prompt 首发 target 的候选生成与发布流程（第一刀）

decisions.text: 候选=机械推导：四组件与 capabilities 逐字段复制观测 descriptor；protocol/launch/overlay 取自 descriptor；permission/data-destination 摘要按域分离 canonical 清单计算（顺序即边界）；actionPolicies 由调用方 actionRequirements 转换。
constraints: no product decisions cast by the module
policy list order is part of the declared boundary
revision must declare the same action tuple at evaluation time

decisions.text: 候选容器 sage.target-requirement-candidate.v1 携带 observedRuntimeDescriptorDigest 且不含 ownerDecision；seal 只在 owner 裁决后经 C2.2T 内核执行，内核校验是唯一门。
constraints: candidate is not a published snapshot
no duplicated or hidden validation
no fixture substitute for publication

decisions.text: 发布流程：候选生成（E 线 descriptor + 物化 profile）→ owner 裁决 → seal requirement + seal matrix（配对重观测的 descriptor digest）→ 随壳加载 → providers 装配 → 撤销源管理；descriptor 移动即候选作废。
constraints: publication re-observes, never trusts the recorded digest
pairing is binding, not endorsement
no fallback on mismatch

decisions.text: 首发范围 session.prompt（external-write / 无决定门）且 capabilities 为空；owner 数据裁决清单（标识时窗、策略清单、组件与模型面、矩阵文案与有效期、撤销节奏）逐项交付由用户裁决。
constraints: owner data decisions stay with the user
no external capabilities in the first scope

decisions.text: 本刀不接准入端口、不改 route 事实、不宣称 target/compat 已接；模块为发布工具线，真实数值与接线属后续票。
constraints: no route authority facts changed
no placeholder wiring
no completion claim for T05

adrs.title: ADR-0277 · C2D.2A：app-bundled Capability Registry provider（内部阶段空快照首发）

decisions.text: 首发快照=内部阶段空集（createdAt 固定、entries 空）；非空条目不得编辑该常量进入出货面，必须走 candidate→verified C2C→owner approval→Matrix→Adapter 链并以新已发布快照到达。
constraints: entries stay empty in the bundled constant
no runtime clock for publication time
non-empty entries only as new published snapshots

decisions.text: 每次 read() 经 C2D.1 kernel 封存并返回深冻结快照；不可封存抛出只带稳定码的错误；构造从不抛出。
constraints: validation only through the kernel
no paths or payload bytes in errors
boot-safe construction

decisions.text: index.ts 构造 bundled provider 并作为 registry 端口交给 runtime inventory 组合；接入后其余输入全真时按既有语义放行 descriptor 与 evidence。
constraints: no other provider semantics changed
unlock only when every other input is real

decisions.text: capabilities 空是机械声明（内部阶段无外部能力获批），与 ADR-0276 首发范围一致；C2C/C2D.2 到达时以新快照放行，不改 provider 形态。
constraints: empty is not a placeholder
no form change on later entries

decisions.text: 门禁登记五组源码事实（构造、接线、kernel 封存、fail-closed、空集常量）并附具名突变；route 权威矩阵与计数不变。
constraints: no exemptions added
counts unchanged
named mutations per fact

adrs.title: ADR-0278 · 首个 session.prompt target 发布件：owner 裁决落地（策略文档 + 首发发布计划）

decisions.text: 模型面严格精确钉：组件逐字段取自发布时重观测的 descriptor；模型/行为变化=矩阵键事件→重发布后才可继续 session.prompt（schema 无 range）。
constraints: no ranges or wildcards
republish on model-face change
fail closed on pair mismatch

decisions.text: 策略文档 canonical 化（sage.target-policy-document.v1，固定键序、独立 digest 命名空间），首发两份逐字采用裁决声明；措辞演进=新版本+新摘要。
constraints: statements ship verbatim
digest binds exactly the canonical bytes
no placeholder digests

decisions.text: 首发发布计划固定：requirement:sage-session-prompt v1.0.0、有效窗 2026-10-11–2027-10-11、action 仅 session.prompt（无决定门）、决策三元（decision:sage-t05-first-session-prompt / owner:sage-product / decidedAt 2026-10-10T09:00:00Z）、提议规则 rule:sage-session-prompt-v1。
constraints: decision <= effectiveAt
action tuple matches the authority table
plan constants frozen

decisions.text: 组合路径唯一：buildSessionPromptPublication(descriptor) 经候选线与 C2.2T 内核封存；descriptor 为输入（发布必须重观测）；本批不跑真实观测、不落 bundle、不接端口。
constraints: kernel is the only validation gate
publication re-observes
no premature wiring

decisions.text: 门禁登记 owner 内容事实（两条声明逐字、标识版本、action 元组、决策三元、封存路径）附五条具名突变；route 计数不变。
constraints: no exemptions added
counts unchanged
named mutations per fact

adrs.title: ADR-0279 · 内测 DMG 链首跑修复：构建脚本批准确认、pnpm 版本单源、运行时内建识别

decisions.text: allowBuilds.esbuild 显式置 true（壳构建链 devDependency，按种子先例格式）；占位符不得留在 manifest。
constraints: no placeholder values in manifests
match the seed precedent format

decisions.text: 根/app/seed 三处 manifest 钉 packageManager=pnpm@11.8.0（=CI 钉值）；隔离 HOME 不再回退最新版本。
constraints: same literal in all three manifests
equals the CI pin

decisions.text: ci-workflow 门禁逐字核对 CI PNPM_VERSION 与三处 packageManager；缺字段或不一致具名判红，附突变自测。
constraints: mechanism over review
named mutations

decisions.text: runtime-graph BUILTINS 显式登记运行时超出宿主列表的内建（首发 sqlite）；新增 pure 回归测试并同步打包测试清单 12→13。
constraints: runtime truth not host truth
regression test in the pure layer
manifest counts stay consistent

decisions.text: store 预取（pnpm fetch）登记为打包操作前置；sign/dmg/acceptance 未跑的步骤照实写未运行。
constraints: no claimed readings without runs
note is the single source of the run ledger

adrs.title: ADR-0280 · target requirement 组件身份语法对齐运行时（首个真实发布件封存）

decisions.text: COMPONENT_IDENTITY 对齐运行时身份语法（小写 kind + @? 有界余段，含 / 与 @）；垃圾仍拒绝。
constraints: must accept every sealed descriptor identity verbatim
bounded length and charset
garbage still rejected

decisions.text: POLICY_IDENTITY 保持 sage 治理命名空间不变；两类身份的语法差异在注释登记。
constraints: published policy documents stay valid
difference documented in code

decisions.text: 首个真实发布件以真实重观测 descriptor 封存；稳定对 target-semantic 3da420a7… × runtime-descriptor e1c7a8b4…；产物仓外留存，bundle/端口属后续票。
constraints: publication re-observed, never fixture
no bundle or port wiring in this cut

decisions.text: requirement spec 新增真实身份接受与垃圾拒绝用例。
constraints: fixtures may not mask runtime-identity assumptions

decisions.text: 首发 effectiveAt 保持 2026-10-11T00:00:00Z；生效前求值答 requirement-not-effective 属设计。
constraints: no plan constants changed

adrs.title: ADR-0281 · C2A canonicalization v2：机器码 artifact 摘要吸收签名变换（含归零 `__LINKEDIT` vmsize）

decisions.text: canonicalizationVersion 升 v2；v1 attestation 在 v2 解析下 fail closed，打包链重跑 producer。
constraints: versioned seam is the canonicalizationVersion field
old digests are rejected loudly, never silently mismatched

decisions.text: Mach-O 文件摘要 = remove-signature 私有副本 + __LINKEDIT.vmsize 归零后哈希；非 Mach-O 原样；executable/path/symlink/metadata 语义不变。
constraints: source tree is never modified
TOCTOU snapshot checks preserved

decisions.text: 非薄片 64 位 LE Mach-O 抛 artifact-normalize-failed，不跳过。
constraints: fail closed on unknown image shapes

decisions.text: packaging 与 sage-shell 两份归一化实现语义逐字相同，各自测试钉住。
constraints: no shared package exists; semantics pinned per package

decisions.text: 回归夹具必须真实改变签名字节（先清零基线 + 断言字节已变），禁止同种重签的字节确定假绿。
constraints: bytes-changed assertion before digest invariance

adrs.title: ADR-0282 · T05-mid 发布票第一刀：requirement 落 bundle 与真实 target 步装配

decisions.text: requirement 以内核封存 snapshot 落 apps/sage-shell/publications/；dev 与打包同相对布局；producer 拷贝整个目录。
constraints: createdAt = owner decision decidedAt for determinism
one relative layout in dev and packaged runtime

decisions.text: 启动时一次读取 + 内核 parse；失败只日志并原样转发；不修复、不默认、不重封、不逐请求重读。
constraints: parse failure never repaired, only forwarded

decisions.text: target 端口：表查 actionScope → 唯一声明 requirement → provider(evaluatedAt=authority.now)；一切失败 → unavailable（不得 denied）；targetRef 绑定 snapshotId+requirementDigest。
constraints: governance absence is never a policy denial
republication moves the target ref by construction

decisions.text: 仅 authority+requirementBundle 同时存在才装配；拒绝码保持 protected-effect-unavailable；stage 不入信封。
constraints: no protocol surface change in this batch
step wiring stays independently observable

decisions.text: route-authority 门禁新增 target 事实组 + 五条具名突变；note 句更新为 target 已真实、停在 compatibility/registry。
constraints: mechanism over review
named mutations for each fact

decisions.text: 不改 owner 数据、不写矩阵、不接 compatibility/registry/persist/dispatch；生效前求值按设计 unavailable。
constraints: no铸造 of governance data
scope limited to requirement half

adrs.title: ADR-0283 · T13-A 治理裁决：外观三族 not-applicable、verified 证据政策、入口语义重述与 Registry 自证等价路线

decisions.text: 外观三族（theme/text-size/ui-scale）记 not-applicable：缩放归平台 zoom，色板不在当前产品面；未来收编=新 ADR/新 DTO/新行。
constraints: decision ref must be a tracked ADR path
rationale is per-row and non-empty

decisions.text: verified 证据政策：acceptance-result.json 稳定命名入仓 docs/notes/implemented/packaging/evidence/，行以 countsAsVerification:true 引用；截图不入 git；文件内机器路径为 sanctioned 历史证据例外。
constraints: only tracked paths count as verification
visualAcceptance keeps a stricter gate

decisions.text: appearance.entry 按 Sage 真实入口（账号菜单→外观与显示）重述；*.open 族观察重述为控件存在+选项集+权威值+保存/回读。
constraints: no product surface change
semantic restatement recorded on the row

decisions.text: Registry 首方 entry 自证等价：provenance = C2A 制品 attestation + 发布决策 + owner 审批；明确不宣称 C2C.5 外部等价。
constraints: no fake external anchor
Registry four-state governance unchanged

decisions.text: 首次应用：8 条外观族行 ui/applicationService/electronAcceptance 升 verified（tracked spec + v2 读数 + route matrix）；hostIntegration/visualAcceptance 保持 pending。
constraints: summary recomputed by derivation
source/prototype PINs untouched

adrs.title: ADR-0284 · T05-mid step 6：矩阵制品发布与真实 compatibility 步装配（评估时点=最后可信观测）

decisions.text: 矩阵 bundle + 空撤销源以内核封存落 publications/；规则=owner 稳定对；窗口与 requirement 对齐；provenance=决策+稳定对域分隔（第一方）。
constraints: same tree and loader layout as the requirement bundle
no external provenance claimed

decisions.text: semantic 由 requirement+观测 descriptor 重建（与候选线同家）；capabilities 非空 fail closed。
constraints: rebuild must pin the published targetSemanticDigest

decisions.text: targetEvidence 全字段确定性推导（域分隔规则见正文）；equivalent→allowed、requires-new-revision→denied、其余→unavailable。
constraints: only a published requires-new-revision rule may deny
evidence carries its own sealed digest

decisions.text: 评估时点=证据 observedAt（最后可信观测）；墙钟新鲜度由 Host 生命周期失效接线恢复（后续票）。显式设计裁决，待用户复核。
constraints: never evaluate at wall-clock now while re-observation is off the path
host lifecycle invalidation is a registered follow-up

decisions.text: revisionDigest 经 store 已校验链暴露（revision-digest-reader，sha256:<hex>|undefined），不造第二套摘要。
constraints: single source: the store validated chain

decisions.text: route-authority 兼容事实组 + 四条具名突变；note 句更新为停在 registry/preflight/persistence。
constraints: named mutations for each fact

adrs.title: ADR-0285 · 首方 Registry entry 与能力发布面：first-party provenance 类、7 键 capability 载体、首个非空快照与重发链

decisions.text: source 扩 first-party；verification 词表不变、由 source 消歧验证路径；digest 命名空间按 source 条件化且不可互换；运行时过滤器同步接受 first-party+verified。
constraints: cross-source namespaces are never interchangeable
no C2C.5 equivalence claimed

decisions.text: requirement capability 载体改 7 键（CompatibilityTargetCapabilityRequirementV1）；空 caps 规范字节不变；候选与 semantic 重建同步。
constraints: empty-capability digests stay stable
rebuild pins the published semantic digest

decisions.text: 首个 registry 快照落 publications/（字节见正文）；effectiveAt=决策时刻；loader 须内核 parse + 重封回同 id 才可取代空集默认。
constraints: bundled default stays the empty set
non-empty only via published snapshot with seal round trip

decisions.text: 重观测即重发：probe 与 index 同款装载 registry；requirement/matrix v2 同批重封并重锚 golden。
constraints: no stale pairing left behind
supersedes chain recorded

decisions.text: route-authority registry 事实组更新 + 两条突变；不变钉子保持。
constraints: mechanism over review

adrs.title: ADR-0286 · 第 7 步 registry 准入接线：三重绑定、裁决失败语义与派生规则单一家

decisions.text: registry 端口消费同实例快照 + requirement + 观测；评估时点=证据 observedAt；三重绑定（快照代/声明一致/审批态）失配即 unavailable。
constraints: evaluation instant is the evidence observedAt
no second registry source

decisions.text: 失败语义：只有 disabled/revoked 答 denied；其余失败答 unavailable；mappingRef 绑定快照 id 与 mapping digest。
constraints: not-provisioned is never dressed as a refusal
exactly one denied exit in the port

decisions.text: capabilityOperationsProjection 与两个摘要派生单一家于 capability-entry-derivation.ts；抽取不得移动既有摘要。
constraints: existing descriptor digests stay byte-identical

decisions.text: options-gated 三输入接线；index 传 bundledRegistry 同实例。
constraints: absence keeps the step absent

decisions.text: route-authority registry 事实组 + 六条具名突变；note 句 registry 移出 absent 名单。
constraints: mechanism over review

adrs.title: ADR-0287 · 第 8 步 preflight：fresh availability、实时 epoch 读与判词边界

decisions.text: preflight v1 = 实时 runtime-effective 观测三步读法（形状/observed/否则 unavailable）；坏链先拒、后触 Host；纯读无时钟。
constraints: an unusable chain never touches the Host
live read per request

decisions.text: preflightRef 域分隔绑定 targetRef/mappingRef/requirementDigest/实时读数；roster 移动即 ref 移动。
constraints: deterministic, no clock

decisions.text: 判词集：永不 denied / stale；运行时缺失=unavailable；再核验归 persistence/dispatch。
constraints: zero denied exits, zero stale exits

decisions.text: 不宣称操作 preflight 完成：boot 静态一致由 inventory 证明；availability 不是 execution authority。
constraints: dispatch stays absent

decisions.text: options-gated 接线复用 Ticket 030 验证闭包；门禁六项事实 + 六条突变；note 句迁出 absent 名单。
constraints: mechanism over review
